description: Volcano Turtle default look, PIXEL-SAMPLED from design/reference/volcano_turtle-character-sheet.webp: the six palette chips (intake.json swatches dark rock 61,57,58 / rock 94,77,71 / tan 170,137,116 / lava red 136,58,47 / lava orange 254,143,58 / flame yellow 254,192,83) cross-checked against the drawn surfaces (service venv PIL, median of a box per surface; boxes in each note). GLOW (drawn on the sheet): the eyes, the lava cracks, the crater rim (+ its drips) and the flame only; tiers lava_drip < crack < eye < crater < flame_outer < flame_inner; peak emission (max channel / 255 x emission_scale x material emission_strength) stays under the 2.0 cap.

plastron.note: tan plastron belly: chip 170,137,116 (x1434 y879); drawn plastron (200,520)-(260,560) median 198,158,130 (lit) / (200,640)-(260,670) 151,114,95 (shaded) -- the chip is the mid tone

plastron_line.note: the three plastron segment lines: drawn line pixels on the x 232 column y 572 = 160,125,102, y 683 = 75,50,38 (soft / dark line art) -- the rock chip 94,77,71 is used; NOT a separate chip, reported

toe.note: tan toe claws: chip 170,137,116; drawn front toe (110,795)-(140,806) median 168,131,107

tail_under.note: tan tail underside (side view draws the lower half of the tail tan: row y 750 x 1180-1240 = 136-180,103-147,84-127): chip 170,137,116

arm_rock.note: arms, oversized fists, rock shoulder plates: chip 94,77,71; drawn front fist (60,600)-(140,630) median 101,79,73, back arm (490,520)-(540,600) 97,77,69, front shoulder block (320,420)-(350,440) 99,75,67

knuckle.note: tan curled fingers under the fists: chip 170,137,116; drawn front knuckles (60,655)-(140,675) median 179,142,117

shell_plate.note: dark faceted shell plates: chip 61,57,58 (x1315 y880); drawn back-view centre plate (650,490)-(730,570) median 62,50,50, lower-left plate (580,580)-(620,640) 53,44,45

shell_rim.note: tan shell rim (+ the shell's flat underside the side view shows tan): chip 170,137,116; drawn back-view rim top (650,400)-(720,405) median 184,144,115

brow.note: the rocky brow blocks: drawn front centre block (222,345)-(244,365) median 31,27,26, side block (170,330)-(186,345) 32,27,26 -- darker than every chip (the drawn fill is used, reported)

eye_socket.note: the dark outline round each glowing eye (FACE DETAIL line art): the brow sample 31,27,26

face_line.note: nostrils + mouth line (FACE DETAIL line art): the brow sample 31,27,26

crack.note: GLOWING lava cracks (arms, shoulder plates, shell seams): chip 254,143,58; drawn front fist crack (60,582)-(140,588) median 240,102,42 (redder than the chip; the chip is used, reported)

lava_drip.note: the darker lava dripping down the head under the crater: chip 136,58,47 (x1494 y878) per the brief's rim pair; drawn drips (215,325)-(245,335) median 244,88,39 and the crater's lower wall (185,318)-(200,328) 113,65,38 -- reported

crater.note: the glowing crater wall, lip and hollow: chip 254,143,58; drawn crater wall (190,295)-(280,320) median 247,97,38, lip (180,288)-(290,292) 221,172,73

flame_outer.note: orange outer flame tongues + the flicks: chip 254,143,58; drawn front flame edge (180,240)-(200,260) median 252,113,48, flick (193,170)-(202,182) 246,93,37

flame_inner.note: yellow inner flame core: chip 254,192,83 (x1614 y878); drawn flame centre (225,255)-(255,280) median 254,225,102 (hotter than the chip; the chip is used)
